notes:
What's new

- Fixed the start-up check added in the previous release: it could be skipped while WinPreview sat idle, which could make the app offer to restore an older version it did not need.
- Rollback backups now also record their version in the backup folder, so recovery works even if the registry entry is missing.
changelog: WinPreview 1.3.11 - start-up health check now runs on its own timer instead of the idle animation pump, so a good launch is always recorded, and rollback backups carry a version marker file.
